dataset_metadata_note: dataset_metadata.json is deliberately NOT hashed: it carries generated_at_utc, which changes on every rebuild by design. Its section_sha256 block is cross-checked against the files by the protocol gate
frozen_matrices_note: these must equal FROZEN_MATRIX_SHA256 and FROZEN_NO_CVE_MATRIX_SHA256 in Test_r27_protocol_provenance.py; Test_h1_seal.py checks that the manifest and the gate agree
note: output/ is gitignored, so the model artefacts are not under version control and this manifest is their seal - the role r24b_baseline_manifest.json plays for arm 1. The contracts, results and gate reports ARE committed; hashing them here pins which revision the seal refers to
policy_code_note: the first three are frozen and sealed at 5e35b2e by arm 1's own manifest; build_unified_v3.py is the field mapping and is sealed here. Hashes are LF-normalised
purpose: the seal on H1: identity layer, field mapping, the two content-sealed matrices, and the R27/R28 results. Anything that changes a hash below reopens H1 and must be an explicit round
reopening_note: changing an identity rule or a field mapping REOPENS H1. The evaluation layer and H2 read this model and never modify it

verified_at_seal.note: sealed_paths_dirty is the section D condition: no file this manifest seals has uncommitted changes. The full status is kept beside it because the generator and its gate are untracked at this moment by construction
